findings.why: refs are one flat namespace and registration accepts any existing ref, but the caller is an admin and sharing a ref is deliberate (code comment calls it possibly-shared)
isPageLiveUnverified blocks pushing a page whose latest apply is unverified, and a later approval re-checks the whole page; remaining gap is narrow
lock held after failed restore is deliberate; an operator close or retry is the documented way out, so deadlock only if the restore fault persists
abortWaiting on timeout is real but deliberate and bounded to 4 waiters, a design choice
keys over 200 chars are ignored as claimed, but the comment documents it as a deliberate choice over a 400
